description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC controller convention called GroupByApiRootConvention which assigns API version group names based on route attributes.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: A convention implementing IControllerModelConvention that groups controllers by their API version derived from route attributes.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Modifies the ControllerModel by setting its ApiExplorer.GroupName based on the route attribute's template.
